== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Zuckuss In Mist Hunter (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with the printed card [[Zuckuss In Mist Hunter]] (Decipher, January 2000): the lower part of the earlier card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>99574a2c79c5e8d535bd619c56f087d38ecbc317</code>.
